params.prompt:
STRICT RULE: Absolutely no music, only diegetic sounds.
Realism cinematic, real skin with pores and small marks, natural eyes, people and set lit only by this place's named sources: the low golden sun behind right, backlighting the maize leaves and rimming the hair, the spaces between the rows in soft shadow; warm natural colour with saturated, believable greens; dust drifting in the air.
Framed on the rule of thirds, with a light anamorphic lens character: softly oval out-of-focus highlights in the background, and a fine 35mm film grain.
Image reference 1 (location Maize field): the Maize field 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 2 (character Young Yash): Young Yash, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 3 (character The teenage boy): The teenage boy, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference; now with coarse rope wound around his chest and arms, binding him upright to the wooden post from S4 on.
Continuity: Young Yash is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; The teenage boy has coarse rope wound around his chest and arms, binding him upright to the wooden post from S4 on.
In frame only: Young Yash and the teenage boy. The trodden path runs from the lens into the rows; the wooden post stands in a small clearing a dozen steps in, screen centre, middle depth. Yash is between the rows, near; the teenage boy stands bound to the post, middle, an arm's length from nobody. Eyelines never at the camera.
Opening: Yash walking between the rows with the leaves closing over his shoulders; the teenage boy standing upright against the post with coarse rope around his chest and arms, his head down, a dozen steps ahead.
The teenage boy speaks aloud 1 time between 7.2s and 9.9s and never again; silent before 7.2s and from 9.9s to the end.
Yash never speaks in this clip.
Yash is out to reach the boy at the post; once the boy calls to him he goes toward him, with grit.
The teenage boy is out to get the rope off; once he sees Yash he calls him over, with tenacity.
Pace: pressing and then sudden; every shot opens in motion, a beat only where his line lands.
S1 0.0-1.5s · full, from the near end of the trodden path looking into the rows, standing eye level, static · the maize leaves move in a light wind with a dry rustle, the trodden path leading in, the wooden post in its clearing ahead; nobody in frame yet.
S2 1.5-3.5s · medium, camera ahead of Yash travelling backward at his shoulder height · Yash pushes through the maize toward the lens, leaves slapping his shoulders, his hands parting the stalks, his look passing right of the lens; only green maize behind him.
S3 3.5-5.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from the post side, slightly high, handheld · Yash stops at a gap in the rows, his hands holding two stalks apart, his look passing left of the lens, level; maize soft behind him.
S4 5.0-7.0s · medium, from the gap at Yash's eye height, slow push-in · the teenage boy stands bound upright to the wooden post in the clearing, coarse rope around his chest and arms, the red S on his shirt facing the lens, his head turning toward the gap; maize rows behind him.
S5 7.0-10.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from the gap side, slightly low, handheld · he strains forward against the rope, the post creaking, his look passing right of the lens, level; his voice begins at 7.2s and ends at 9.9s; only maize behind him.
S6 10.0-11.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, from the front, slightly low, static · Yash's hands drop from the stalks, his look going right past the lens toward the post, level; maize behind him.
S7 11.0-12.8s · medium, camera behind Yash at his shoulder height travelling with him · Yash steps out of the gap into the clearing and takes three steps toward the post; the teenage boy at the post in the middle distance ahead, his face toward Yash; maize either side.
S8 12.8-14.4s · full, from behind Yash at the edge of the clearing, standing eye level, static · the maize behind the post bends away in one wave from left to right across the whole field with a rising rush of wind at 12.9s, the post and the bound boy at the centre, Yash in the near foreground with his back to the lens.
S9 14.4-16.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, from the front, slightly low, handheld · Yash's right forearm comes up across his eyes, his hair blown flat by the gust, leaves flying past him; the bending maize behind him.
S10 16.0-18.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from the post side, slightly high, slow push-in · white light floods in from the right across his raised forearm and face and the picture washes toward white, the roar peaking at 17.0s; the maize behind him flattening.
All speech is in Hindi. Only the words inside double quotation marks are ever spoken aloud; every voice direction and every other word of this text stays silent.
S5 (7.2-9.9s) The teenage boy to Yash, a boy's voice, hoarse, strained and urgent, pleading and raw: "रुको! मेरी रस्सी खोल दो!"
No speech in S1, S2, S3, S4, S6, S7, S8, S9, S10.
Restrictions:
- No music of any kind: no score, no soundtrack, no background music, no melody, no drone, no pad, no sting, no swell.
- No added sound effects: no whoosh, no boom, no impact hit, no riser.
- Only diegetic sound: the characters' voices and the natural sounds of this place.
- No words but the quoted lines, each only inside its own Audio window; outside them no one on screen speaks, whispers or mouths a word.
